# #608 — search-all: proc.kill TypeError in the qmd-search timeout race — intermittent db-integration failures

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-08-07T22:08:02Z
Updated: 2026-08-07T22:08:02Z

---

Found by the #592 CI-repair lane, 2026-08-07, while proving its own failures were unrelated.

`src/tools/search-all.ts:110` — when the timeout wins the `Promise.race`, the loser path calls `proc.kill` and throws `TypeError: proc.kill is not a function`. Fires only on timeout, hence intermittent: green on main's last 6 db-integration runs, red on one run of the #592 push, passed on re-run. The branch that observed it was byte-identical to main in that file.

Not fixed in #592 (smallest-correct-change scope: unrelated main-owned code). Suggested done-means: a test that forces the timeout branch and asserts the process handle is terminated without throwing.
